item.title: CCT Promotes Sherry Stewart To Vice President Of Finance
item.description: CCT has promoted Sherry Stewart, CPA, to Vice President of Finance, elevating a longtime finance leader who has helped guide the company’s financial operations through years of growth and increasing complexity.
